import seaborn as sns

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Convert categorical variables to numerical
credit_fraud['transaction_type'] = credit_fraud['transaction_type'].map({'refund': 0, 'payment': 1, 'transfer': 2}).astype(int)

# Create a bar chart to compare the frequency of different transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=credit_fraud, hue='is_fraud')
plt.title('Frequency of Transaction Types by Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
